title: AI in banking: Insights on turning AI into ROI
summary: t’s important to note that AI in banking is no longer a future consideration. Rather, it’s fast becoming an operational imperative, powering automation, unlocking insights, and reshaping traditional workflows. 2025 CGI Voice of Our Clients research confirms this. Nearly 60% of the executives interviewed in the asset/wealth management and capital markets sectors have a holistic AI strategy, while nearly 40% of retail banking and corporate banking executives say the same.
